baseline_models.focus_anchor: The WLY term is predicated across both near life and the latter phase.
baseline_models.mechanism: No-gap nearness, succession, entrusted care, and aid combine into a protective office that continues as one phase follows another.

activation_trace.role: Immediate nearness supplies the spatial basis for allies who remain present.
Uninterrupted succession makes the two named phases continuous rather than isolated.
Taking charge turns companionship into an active office of care.
Love and aid give that office its benevolent direction.
The nearer or first realm establishes the initial phase of coverage.
What comes after establishes the succeeding phase without ending the relation.

changed_reading.before: We are your friends in this life and the next.
changed_reading.after: We stand immediately near, take charge, and aid you as one phase follows the other without a break.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The declaration of WLY care is followed by the twice-repeated possession frame, for you in it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Entrusted oversight and the assignment of good recast life as administered benefit belonging to the whole self, not merely company plus detachable gifts.

activation_trace.role: Oversight supplies the administrative function behind the promised provision.
Assigning a good to someone links the repeated possession clauses to the allies' care.
Life as benefit and good makes the environment itself part of the gift.
The self as the whole entity makes provision answer to the person in full.

changed_reading.before: Companions reassure the recipients and gifts are available.
changed_reading.after: The allies actively administer a beneficial life-world whose provisions belong to the recipients as whole selves.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: What the selves desire is paired with what the recipients call for or claim, each under the same possession formula.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inward pull can remain intention, recur as desire, or become voiced request and asserted claim; the parallel clauses bring all stages into recognized possession.

activation_trace.role: The inward pull toward an object supplies the unspoken beginning of the sequence.
Desire recurring after desire opens the clause beyond a single fixed wish.
Intention held within the self locates desire before it is verbalized.
Calling by speech converts inward inclination into an addressed request.
Asserting a right adds the stronger possibility of recognized entitlement.

changed_reading.before: The recipients get things they want.
changed_reading.after: Whether desire remains inward or becomes a voiced request or claim, it is recognized within the same for-you order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence binds people to companions who beautify their horizon, then exposes enemies and misleaders. WLY nearness in the focus becomes the benevolent counter-form of captured adjacency: a relation that aids instead of manipulating.

activation_trace.role: No-gap nearness anchors the focus as an alternative kind of adjacency.
Aid and loyal affection reverse the harmful direction of the prior companionship.
Binding one thing to another supplies the coercive relational structure being countered.
An attached companion gives that binding a social agent.
Making something appear attractive explains how the harmful companions govern perception.
Explicit enmity supplies the negative pole against which WLY aid is read.
Departure from right direction identifies the destructive effect of the former relation.

structural_cues: The packet moves from attached companions in 41:25 through enemies and exposed misleaders in 41:28-29 to descending reassurance in 41:30 and WLY speech in 41:31.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful attachment, beautification, enmity, misdirection, and then benevolent WLY language; I supply a contrastive replacement arrow. A live alternative is simple juxtaposition of two populations rather than replacement of one companion system by another.

changed_reading.after: The speakers are a counter-companionship that displaces manipulative attachment with immediate, loyal, direction-preserving care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Angelic descent before the focus gives the first-person plural an arriving agency, while prepared guest provision immediately after it turns guardianship into escort and reception across a threshold.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge defines the office announced by the arriving speakers.
Successive continuity lets that office span arrival, transition, and reception.
Coming down and alighting supplies the attendants' movement toward the addressed people.
The angel branch identifies the class of descending agents behind the plural reassurance.
A spoken promise opens the expected future into which the attendants escort them.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest converts the promised objects into hospitality.
Protective covering from the effect of fault gives the reception a restorative quality.
Tender mercy gives the prepared reception its affective source.

structural_cues: The plural angels of 41:30 flow directly into the plural we of 41:31, and 41:32 appositionally names prepared reception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, angels, promise, first-person plural speech, and guest provision; I infer continuity of attendants and a threshold-crossing host function. Alternatively, the plural may include a broader divine retinue, and the guest provision may qualify the gifts without defining the speakers' role.

changed_reading.before: Allies remain with the recipients in two realms and gifts await there.
changed_reading.after: Descending attendants escort the recipients across the boundary, announce their continuing office, and receive them with prepared, restorative hospitality.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, sustenance within the earth is deliberately apportioned for askers and the near heaven is guarded. Those images activate the repeated in-it and for-you clauses as a cosmic provisioning pattern: response is fitted and secured rather than accidental.

activation_trace.role: Personal inclination supplies the recipient-side measure to which provision answers.
Voiced calling links the focus gift to the earlier category of askers.
Oversight supplies the agency that keeps fitted provision available.
Deliberate assessment and arrangement supply a model of provision by design.
Sustenance that maintains life gives the designed measure concrete content.
Asking and seeking connect cosmic allotment to the focus act of calling for something.
The near realm echoes the focus's near-life term and carries the provision pattern toward it.
Guarding and watching make the prepared order durable rather than exposed.

structural_cues: 41:10 repeats the same in-it frame around stable earth, blessing, measured sustenance, and askers; 41:12 then couples the near realm with guarding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured sustenance for askers and a guarded near realm; I infer an analogical continuity with the focus's desired and called-for provision. A live alternative is that the focus's unrestricted relative pronoun stresses plenitude rather than fit or measure.

changed_reading.before: Every wish is met as unrestricted abundance.
changed_reading.after: Desired and requested provision is also read as personally fitted, deliberately administered, and securely maintained within a larger created order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, calling can invite toward God, be refused, target objects that vanish, or expand under distress. The focus's call is changed by WLY backing: its efficacy rests in a stable relation and direction, not in vocal intensity or wanting by itself.

activation_trace.role: Addressed calling supplies the shared action whose direction and outcome vary across the surah.
A claim of right makes the focus call stronger than an unbacked cry.
An invitation rejected by blocked hearers supplies an early case of a call whose reception fails.
Calling toward God supplies the positive orientation of speech in the later sequence.
Freedom from harm and defect marks the caller's declared alignment.
Formerly invoked objects supply the failed-address contrast.
Loss of the invoked objects shows that a call can lack any enduring relational support.
Never tiring of repetition supplies intensity without guaranteeing right orientation.
Repeated calling for good supplies the unstable human appetite nearest to the focus promise.
Crisis prayer supplies another call driven by need rather than settled relation.
The side-and-width image joins turning aside with an expansive prayer, exposing the caller's oscillation.

structural_cues: The D-W root recurs in packet order as refused invitation, focus claim, exemplary invitation, vanished invocation, tireless petition, and broad crisis prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent calling with sharply different directions and outcomes; I infer that WLY relation is the focus's stabilizing difference. Alternatively, the forms may simply realize distinct syntactic senses without forming a surah-wide circuit.

changed_reading.before: Whatever the recipients ask for is available.
changed_reading.after: What they call for is effective because the call is rightly oriented and backed by enduring guardianship, unlike vanished invocation or volatile need-prayer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Body surfaces testify, action returns to one's own self, and signs become clear within selves. The desiring NFS in the focus therefore expands from appetite-bearer to the whole inward, embodied, consequence-bearing person.

activation_trace.role: The self as the entity in full anchors desire in a whole person rather than an isolated faculty.
Inner intention preserves the inward dimension of that whole person.
Inclination remains the immediate focus action but no longer exhausts the meaning of self.
Presence with observation turns embodied faculties into participants in disclosed identity.
The body's covering supplies the outward surface that nevertheless bears inner history.
The whole self receives the consequence of its own action, adding responsibility to identity.
What lies within the self becomes a site where signs are disclosed.
Making truth manifest gives the inward signs an evidentiary outcome.
Knowledge-based testimony closes the movement from hidden self to disclosed truth.

structural_cues: The whole-surah order moves from involuntary bodily testimony in 41:20-22 to action for or against the self in 41:46 and signs within selves in 41:53.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies embodied testimony, self-returning action, and inward signs; I infer continuity of the self whose desire is answered. A live alternative is that these passages contrast accountable rejecters with the focus recipients and do not qualify desire itself.

changed_reading.before: The appetite-bearing selves receive their preferred objects.
changed_reading.after: The whole inward and embodied persons, who bear their histories and become sites of disclosure, have their desire answered as integrated selves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descending water moves and raises a lifeless earth before the same HYY root names its revival and the revival of the dead. This makes care in near life and the latter phase a continuity through transformation, not mere presence at two addresses.

activation_trace.role: One thing following another without interruption supplies continuity through the threshold.
Earth-life through rain gives the focus life-term a renewable material image.
The nearer phase supplies the first side of the transformation.
The phase after it supplies the revived side of the sequence.
Delivered descent supplies the enabling input that reaches dormant earth.
Water conveyed by pouring gives the descending input its life-bearing material.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life marks dormant matter becoming active.
Nourishment and growth supply the expansion that follows reactivation.
Reviving earth through rain explicitly joins the focus life-root to the material sequence.
Loss of life supplies the boundary that revival crosses.

structural_cues: 41:39 explicitly moves from low, still earth through descent, movement, growth, enlivening, and the dead; the focus pairs near life with what comes after.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a full revival sequence and the focus's two life phases; I infer a lifecycle analogy in which guardianship persists through transformation. Alternatively, 41:39 may only demonstrate power to resurrect and leave the semantics of WLY in 41:31 unchanged.

changed_reading.before: The allies are present during two successive periods.
changed_reading.after: Their care persists through the death-to-revival transformation, carrying life forward as dormant earth is reactivated and raised.

context_deltas.mechanism: The better act actively pushes away harm until enmity appears as intimate WLY relation. The focus ally-term therefore becomes not only an identity label but also the stable endpoint of a reversible social field.

activation_trace.role: Loyal affection and aid define the focus relation that later appears as the reversal endpoint.
Pushing harm aside supplies the causal action that changes the social field.
Good contrasted with ugly conduct supplies the positive force used in that action.
Enmity establishes the initial relational state to be reversed.
The same aided-affection branch marks the transformed relation.
Near kinship intensifies the endpoint from alliance to intimate closeness.
Holding the self against distress supplies the durability required for reversal.

structural_cues: 41:34 places enmity and WLY relation in a sudden before-and-after construction, then 41:35 restricts reception of the practice to those who endure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repulsion by the better act, enmity, sudden WLY intimacy, and endurance; I infer that focus allyhood can function as a relational template that propagates into human conduct. Alternatively, 41:34 may be a separate ethical exhortation with only lexical echo.

changed_reading.before: The focus names a fixed class of celestial allies.
changed_reading.after: It also activates allyhood as a relation whose protected pattern can reverse hostility into intimate, aiding nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a specialized agrarian WLY branch rather than the ordinary ally sense. It remains anchored in the focus WLY and HYY roots and is reinforced by 41:39's descent-to-growth sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for recurrent care, never as a lexical translation of the allies as rain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: WLY in the declaration of guardianship stands beside life across successive phases.

activation_trace.role: Rain following an earlier rain supplies an unusual image of care arriving in life-giving succession.
Earth revived by rain ties that succession to the focus's life term.
Water delivered downward supplies the arriving aid in the analogy.
The earth's life-stirring movement shows the effect of that arrival.
Nourished growth supplies the sustained result of recurrent care.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their continuing care can be imaged as successive life-giving arrivals that stir latent capacity into growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant D-AA mapping for the focus D-W root and crosses from speech into container mechanics. It remains formally anchored by that supplied mapping and gains support from measured sustenance and prepared hospitality. Downstream prose should label it a branch-activated provisioning image, not a proposed gloss or morphology for the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final for-you clause attaches the focus D-W form to unrestricted availability.

activation_trace.role: Moving a vessel until it fully takes its contents supplies the branch-distant image of provision filled to capacity.
A measure reaching its proper limit gives the filled-capacity image disciplined scale.
Life-maintaining sustenance gives the filled measure useful content.
Prepared guest provision relocates the container image into hospitality rather than acquisition.

changed_reading.before: Whatever is requested can be obtained.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, whatever is called for appears as hospitality worked to a full and fitting capacity rather than a sparse allotment.

strongest_changes: WLY becomes a counter-companionship that replaces manipulative attachment with loyal, direction-preserving care.
The 41:30-32 frame turns continuous guardianship into angelic escort and prepared reception across a threshold.
The surah-wide D-W circuit distinguishes a WLY-backed call from refused invitation, vanished invocation, and volatile crisis prayer.
The NFS that desires expands into the whole embodied, accountable, and evidentiary self.
The revival sequence in 41:39 makes continuity across near life and the latter phase a passage through transformation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed two opposed companion systems and a distributed calling circuit, while the immediate frame supplied descent and hospitality. Material sequences of measured sustenance and revived earth then changed both provision and temporal continuity without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The continuity between the angels of 41:30 and the first-person plural of 41:31 is strong but the plural's exact scope remains open.
Measured cosmic sustenance may analogize the focus provision without limiting the plenitude of its unrestricted relative clauses.
The accountable-self model does not establish that desire is filtered; it only changes who the desiring self is.
The follow-on rain and non-dominant D-AA activations must remain qualified material analogies rather than lexical glosses.
